content: The first Tasks tab had a 'Queue a requirement' capture bar above a list whose every group already had an inline '+ Add task' row. The user asked what it was for - it was a leftover from the pre-asoode version and did exactly what the To Do group's add row did. Removed it. Note the follow-on: deleting it created a dead end when the list was empty, so the list view is now always rendered (it forces a To Do group) rather than being replaced by an empty-state card.
